task.name: Protect_drinking_water_supply
task.when: When the Dominatrix determines that the fresh-water supply is too low for showers

step.action: Close the camp shower to users.
Display 🔧 Out_of_Service_Sign at the shower entrance.
Record the shower closure and water-service need in 📦 Camp_Issue_Log.

passWhen.criterion: The shower is closed and visibly marked out of service.
Both kitchen drinking-water dispensers are full.
